description: Takes in one order file in a single run. A tidy file (a spreadsheet, CSV, Word table or typed PDF with a table this script knows) is read with no AI; anything else is handed to the agent to read, and what the agent read is then held against the file's own text. Records the order, finds the customer, matches every line and converts units by the same rules as before, and says who goes on: the check, a person, or the agent. Jev answers the two yes/no questions (is a typed message an order; do the customer's notes ask for anything on this order).
